name: PT Puradelta Lestari Tbk
summary: PT Puradelta Lestari Tbk engages in the residential, commercial, and industrial real estate businesses in Indonesia. The company operates through Property, Hotel, and Others segments. Its portfolio includes Kota Deltamas, an independent city consisting of residential properties; commercial properties, such as shophouses; and industrial properties, including greenland international industrial center, and rents factory. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Jakarta Barat, Indonesia. PT Puradelta Lestari Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Sumber Arusmulia.
